findings.condition: Default saved assembly with both wideband interfaces populated.

R36 near line 14746 and R37 near line 18669; both DNP
Carrier termination conductance calculation and stated exclusions

findings.location: Internal CAN2 bus, R36/R37 and module interface J2
findings.mechanism: Both carrier termination resistors are omitted, leaving no populated resistive termination across CAN2 on the carrier.
findings.reasoning: Native schematic and board agree that the only two cross-bus resistors are 120-ohm DNP parts. Their assembled termination conductance is therefore zero. Termination inside the attached module or harness is not established by this packet. Without module internals, bitrate or waveform measurements, this remains an unresolved termination concern rather than demonstrated CAN failure.
findings.title: Internal CAN2 termination depends on an unverified external implementation

limitations: Manufacturer documentation retrieval failed DNS resolution; part ratings, supplier identities and all physical pin functions were not independently qualified.
Polygonus, Atlas and wideband module internals, firmware and integrated FOME-MC behavior were not reviewed.
Startup, shutdown, reset, brownout, power sequencing, tolerance corners and loaded operating limits were not simulated or measured.
No validated device-level models or dynamic electrical tests were supplied; native check success does not establish electrical behavior.
CAN signal integrity, sensor waveforms, ignition energy, automotive transients, EMC and thermal qualification remain unverified.
No zone refill, complete mating/mechanical review, manufacturing approval or original as-received checkout review was performed.
